name: v0.1.8 - Typed roll detection; in-combat fix for unlinked tokens
body:
## Fixed

- **In-combat detection works for unlinked tokens.** Previously the predicate compared `combatant.actorId` against `actor.id`, which fails for unlinked tokens because their synthetic-actor `.id` is not the world-actor's id. The predicate now also matches by `combatant.tokenId === actor.token.id`. Tokens correctly swap when added to combat and revert when combat ends or is deleted.

## Changed

- **CPR roll detection rewritten** for granular state buckets:
  - `cpr.rolling.attack` — every attack roll, regardless of weapon (one bucket per user request).
  - `cpr.rolling.deathSave`, `cpr.rolling.initiative`, `cpr.rolling.damage`, `cpr.rolling.stat`, `cpr.rolling.role` — typed per CPR roll subclass.
  - `cpr.rolling.skill` — generic catch-all for any skill check.
  - `cpr.rolling.skill.<slug>` — per-skill states (e.g. `cpr.rolling.skill.animal_handling`, `cpr.rolling.skill.sea_vehicle_tech`). Registered for every unique skill in your world at install. Per-skill states have higher priority, so a configured per-skill image wins over the generic one.

## Architecture note

CPR's `CPRRoll` subclasses do not extend Foundry's `Roll` and CPR explicitly omits roll info from chat messages (Dice So Nice integration). v0.1.7's `createChatMessage`-only listener could not type the roll. v0.1.8 monkey-patches `CPRChat.RenderRollCard` on the rolling client to inspect the `cprRoll` instance directly (class name plus `skillName` / `entityData`), then stamps the typed info as a flag in `preCreateChatMessage`. The flag rides the socket to every client so each one knows what kind of roll just happened — no per-entry-point wrapping needed (sheet, Token Action HUD, macros, `/red` command all work).

**Manifest:** `module.json`
**Module:** `module.zip`

name: v0.1.7 - Fix combat clear; simplify roll detection (createChatMessage)
body:
Fixes two reported bugs.

(1) Token didn't change back when combat ended or encounter was deleted. The trigger bus now sweeps every token on the active scene whenever ANY combat event fires (combatStart, deleteCombat, updateCombat with active/turn/round changes, createCombatant, deleteCombatant). Previously deleteCombat tried to iterate combat.combatants which may already be empty by the time the hook fires.

(2) Roll detection didn't fire for handgun, handgun-skill, attack-with-medium-pistol, or attack-with-targeted-token rolls. The previous _onRoll prototype patch was bypassed by Token Action HUD and other code paths. v0.1.7 listens to createChatMessage instead - CPR creates a chat card for EVERY roll regardless of entry point, so this catches all of them. Simplified to one generic 'cpr.rolling' state (no weapon-type breakdown) per user request. 2.5s window. State map reduced from 11 to 6: dead, unconscious, bloodied, wounded, cpr.rolling, inCombat.

name: v0.1.6 - Fix inCombat trigger + working CPR roll detection
body:
Two fixes:

- inCombat trigger no longer requires c.active flag (V12 doesn't always set it when adding combatants to the tracker, so swaps weren't firing even after Begin Combat). Now any combatant referencing the actor counts as in-combat.

- CPR ephemeral roll-state detection now works! Diagnostic confirmed CPRRoll is encapsulated inside CPR's bundle and unreachable. Switched to wrapping _onRoll on the four CPR actor sheet classes (Character/Mook/BlackIce/Demon — all exposed via game.cpr.apps). Reads rollType + itemId from the event's data attributes, fires the ephemeral state for ~2.5s.

Direct upgrade from v0.1.5.

name: v0.1.5 - Engine fix; CPR roll-class probe
body:
Two real engine bugs + CPR detection improvement:

- States without configured images no longer block lower-priority states. Previously, if 'unconscious' matched but had no image, it locked the state and prevented re-evaluation when the actor healed. Now states without effective payloads are transparent to the resolver.

- CPR roll-class detection now probes known global locations (globalThis.CPRRoll, game.cpr.rolls.CPRRoll, CONFIG.Dice.rolls) instead of the broken dynamic import of source-tree paths. CPR ships as a bundled cpr.js, so the source path 404'd on installed instances.

Persistent states (wounded, bloodied, unconscious, dead, inCombat) should now correctly transition both directions. Ephemeral roll states (cpr.rolling.*) require finding CPRRoll on a known global; if not found, they remain disabled gracefully and the warning explains how the persistent states still work.

Direct upgrade from v0.1.4.

name: v0.1.4 - Fix TDZ ReferenceError in CPR shim
body: Hotfix: v0.1.3 still failed on V12 because cyberpunk-red-core.mjs's STATES array used template literal \\.systemEvent\ at module-load time. The circular import (module.mjs imports cyberpunk-red-core.mjs which imports module.mjs back) put MODULE_ID in the temporal dead zone, throwing 'Cannot access MODULE_ID before initialization' at line 168. v0.1.4 hardcodes the hook name string. Direct upgrade from v0.1.3.

name: v0.1.3 - Fix V12 load failure (lazy class definition)
body:
Hotfix: v0.1.0/v0.1.1/v0.1.2 silently failed to load on V12 because the apps destructured foundry.applications.api at top-level (module-load time, when that namespace may still be undefined). v0.1.3 builds the ApplicationV2-derived classes lazily inside the init hook. Also removes orphan code at end of actor-config-app.mjs and adds startup log lines so any future load failures are diagnosable.

Direct upgrade from v0.1.x. After update + reload, console should show:

  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | module.mjs loaded
  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | actor-config-app loaded; header-button hooks registered
  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | module-settings-app loaded
  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | trigger bus installed
  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | CPR shim installed (11 states)
  vebjorns-state-aware-tokens | ready (system: cyberpunk-red-core)

And a theatrical-mask 'State-Aware Tokens' button on every actor sheet header (GM only).

name: v0.1.2 - Wire actor-config import; defensive actor lookup
body:
Hotfix on top of v0.1.1.

The v0.1.0/v0.1.1 build had the actor-config-app.mjs file present but never side-effect-imported from module.mjs, so its Hooks.on listeners never registered. Result: no theatrical-mask header button appeared on V12 actor sheets, and no console output from actor-config-app.

v0.1.2 wires the side-effect import in module.mjs, adds a defensive _resolveActor helper for V1 (app.actor/app.object) vs V2 (app.document) sheet differences in V12, and adds a startup log line so module-load failures are distinguishable from loaded-but-no-button-rendered.

Direct upgrade from v0.1.x. No settings changed.

name: v0.1.1 - Fix missing header button on system actor sheets
body: Fixes a regression where the State-Aware Tokens header button never appeared on actor sheets in systems that subclass ActorSheet (CPR, dnd5e, pf2e, etc). v0.1.0 used hooks that only fire for the literal ActorSheet base class. v0.1.1 uses renderActorSheet + DOM injection — the same pattern Theatre Inserts, PopOut!, and Item Piles use, which works across all systems.

name: v0.1.0 - Initial scaffold (CPR-ready)
body:
First release. Generic priority-ordered state machine with Cyberpunk Red Core integration shim. Ships per-actor image picker UI; light-field UI and custom-state UI ship in v0.1.1.

Required: lib-wrapper.

Install URL: https://github.com/VebjornNyvoll/vebjorns-state-aware-tokens/releases/latest/download/module.json
